description: GIPOD road works and street occupations our daily archive captured within a radius of a point or address in or around Antwerp (15 km from the centre, from April 2026), with first and last seen days and every change to their published start, end or status. Read the coverage block first: it lists days the archive missed, and an 'unavailable' state means unknown, not quiet.

address.description: Street address in Belgium, e.g. 'Lange Lozanastraat 142, 2018 Antwerpen'. Use instead of lat/lng.

lat.description: Latitude of the point. Must be inside Flanders (Brussels and Wallonia are not covered). Pair with lng.

lng.description: Longitude of the point. Pair with lat.

locationId.description: Id of one of the account's saved locations, from stadiq_locations. Use instead of lat/lng.

since.description: First day of the window. Default: start of the archive.

until.description: Last day of the window. Default: today.

name: stadiq_history
title: GIPOD history around a point
